title: SS27 Girls' Casualwear Styling
summary: Casual girlswear: tee and bike shorts, terry sets, denim skirts and sandals.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- MilK's Dressing Idéal chose matching sets by Catimini and Semon ApartMent, a terry top by Piupiuchick, pyjamas by Oda London, a sailor top by Loir Paris, and shoes by Tnin and Affenzahn<sup>[1]</sup>
- Fatamadrina lists relaxed shapes, dungarees, oversized T-shirts, pleated dresses and lightweight jackets as SS27 silhouettes<sup>[2]</sup>
- Pisamonas showed strap ballerinas, leather sandals, barefoot models and first-summer shoes for babies<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Formulas
sections.body:
- **Oversized tee + bike shorts.**
- **Terry set + sandals.**
- **Stripe tee + denim skirt.**
- **Matching printed set.**

design_implications:
- Sets as separates.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
